regime.label: Dealer long-gamma pin on the 1080-1100 shelf with 5 sessions to expiry
evidence: +16,194 net GEX across the chain, +15,810 of it inside 20 points of the 1,083.1 anchor - dealers are long gamma and fade moves rather than chase them.
1,080 gamma flip sits only 3.1 points below spot; cumulative GEX is -2,330 at 1,070, so a 3-point slip hands dealers short gamma again.
2,949 call OI at 1,100 on 292 lots traded is the live near-money wall, while the 16,430-lot 910 put wall traded 2 lots 173 points away - stale structural OI, not active burden (Vol2Vol).
13.22% ATM IV prices a 9.0-point daily 1-sigma, roughly 20 points across the 5 remaining sessions, and is down from 13.54% five sessions ago.

S50U26.today_summary: 1,083.1 sits 13.1 points above the 1,070 max pain and 3.1 points above the 1,080 gamma flip, with +15,810 of net GEX stacked across 1,080, 1,090 and 1,100. 2.44 P/C OI is standing hedge inventory rather than a bearish vote - 45,350 put OI against 18,551 call OI has barely moved in eight sessions. 1.63 P/C volume with 268 lots at the 1,070 put and 262 at 1,050 reads as downside rolling, not fresh panic. The effective magnet is the 1,080-1,100 gamma shelf, not the 1,070 max pain, which itself carries -1,518 GEX.
what_changed: Net GEX +16,194 today against -7,319 on 2026-09-17 - a full dealer short-to-long gamma sign flip inside five sessions.
Gamma flip migrated 1,100 to 1,080 on 2026-09-22 and spot has now closed above it three sessions running.
ATM IV 13.22% versus 13.49% yesterday and 13.54% on 09-17 - steady compression into expiry.
Call volume fell to 1,087 from 1,312 while put volume rose to 1,769, yet put OI held at 45,350 vs 45,195 - rotation of flow, not an unwind.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: 25.3 points of anchor recovery since the 1,057.8 print on 2026-09-17 flipped dealer gamma from -7,319 to +16,194, the highest-signal event in the window. The gamma flip walked down 1,100 to 1,080 while spot walked up, so the level that capped price on 09-17 now sits underneath it as a stabiliser. Max pain has not moved off 1,070 in eight sessions and the 1,100 call wall and 910 put wall are frozen, so the entire migration is in gamma, not in OI placement. ATM IV compressed 13.54% to 13.22% with total OI flat at 63,901 contracts - no unwind and no fresh protection bid. The structure reads as a maturing pin on 1,080-1,100, fragile only across the 3.1 points between spot and the flip.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1050P / 1070P x 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: +15,810 of ATM net GEX with 5 DTE is the textbook long-gamma pin, and both short strikes sit on live OI shelves - 1,731 put OI at 1,070 with 268 lots traded, 2,949 call OI at 1,100 with 292 - outside the 9.0-point daily sigma.
strategies.defined_risk: 20-point wing width minus roughly 3.2 points of net credit at mid = 16.8 points maximum loss per side, or 3,360 baht at 200 baht per point.
strategies.invalidation: A close below the 1,080 gamma flip or above the 1,100 call wall.

strategies.name: Put credit spread 1070 / 1050
strategies.rationale: 13.1 points above max pain and above the 1,080 flip, long-gamma dealers buy dips; the 1,070 short strike is the 25-delta put band and carries 1,731 contracts of standing OI.
strategies.defined_risk: 20-point width minus roughly 2.1 points of net credit at mid = 17.9 points maximum loss, or 3,580 baht at 200 baht per point.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1,080 - cumulative GEX is -2,330 at 1,070, where dealer hedging amplifies the move instead of fading it.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1080 / 1060 (tail hedge)
strategies.rationale: 3.1 points is all that separates spot from the 1,080 flip, and below it the -2,330 cumulative GEX at 1,070 turns dealers into sellers of weakness - 4.7 points caps that tail for a short-vol book.
strategies.defined_risk: 4.7 points of net debit at mid = 4.7 points maximum loss, or 940 baht; maximum gain 15.3 points at or below 1,060.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1,100 with the flip holding at 1,080 - the hedge decays while the pin stays intact.

S50U26.prediction: 1,074-1,092, one 9.0-point sigma either side of the 1,080 gamma shelf, is the base case into the 2026-09-29 expiry, with +15,810 of ATM GEX fading moves in both directions. A close below 1,080 is what breaks it: cumulative GEX is -2,330 at 1,070 and dealer hedging would amplify toward the 1,050 near put wall. Above 1,100 the 2,949-lot call wall caps the drift rather than triggering a squeeze, because cumulative GEX stays positive all the way to 1,150.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is recommended. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1,080-1,100 magnet as a tendency, not a guarantee. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the 16.8-point condor maximum loss is real, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright.

regime.label: Young back-quarter building protection with dealer gamma still near zero
evidence: +450 total net GEX across the whole chain - 2.8% of the front series' +16,194 - so dealer gamma is effectively flat and no strike has grip on price.
1,130 gamma flip sits 46.7 points above the 1,083.3 anchor and has walked down from 1,150 on 09-16, leaving spot in the sub-flip zone.
3,607 put OI against 2,593 six sessions ago (+39%) versus 3,211 call OI (+21%) - protection is being built, with no near-money strike above 292 contracts.
12.04% ATM IV is the lowest of the seven-session window (12.95% on 09-16) while the 960 put prints 17.19% against the 960 call's 9.75% - vega cheap at the money, dear in the tail.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1,083.3 sits almost exactly on the 1,080 max pain, which drifted up 10 points today from 1,070 for the first time in seven sessions. 1.12 P/C OI and 1.83 P/C volume show puts accumulating faster than calls, on 309 put lots against 169 call lots. No near-money strike carries more than 529 contracts (the 1,100 call), so there is no wall to lean on; the 563-lot 960 put is a structural floor 123 points away. +450 of net GEX across 20 strikes means dealer hedging has almost no grip on this series yet.
what_changed: Max pain moved 1,070 to 1,080, the first drift in seven sessions, tracking the anchor 11.3 points higher than 1,072 on 09-16.
Put OI 3,607 versus 3,351 yesterday and 2,593 on 09-16 (+39%) - the protection build accelerated.
Gamma flip descended 1,150 to 1,140 to 1,130 over six sessions as call OI stacked at 1,100 and 1,150.
ATM IV 12.04% is a seven-session low, down from 12.95% on 09-16 even as put OI rose.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: 1,083.3 is 23.2 points above the 1,060.1 anchor of 2026-09-17, and the December series answered with protection rather than chase: put OI +39% to 3,607 while call OI added 21% to 3,211. Net GEX has stayed inside a +190 to +489 band all week - no sign flip and no dealer grip, which is why this series offers neither a pin nor a squeeze. The gamma flip has walked 1,150 to 1,130 as call OI built at 1,100 and 1,150, so the structure is drifting toward spot rather than away from it. ATM IV compressed 12.95% to 12.04% into that build, the one genuine change: insurance is being bought while its price falls. With 96 DTE and a 25-delta skew flat at -0.06 against a 7.4-point put-over-call tail skew at 960, the cheap expression sits in the wings, not the body.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050 / 1000

strategies.defined_risk: 7.65 points of net debit at mid = 7.65 points maximum loss, or 1,530 baht at 200 baht per point; maximum gain 42.35 points at or below 1,000.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1,100 with the gamma flip holding at 1,130 - the hedge bleeds while the protection bid goes unused.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1100 / 1150
strategies.rationale: 12.04% ATM IV at a seven-session low makes the 96-DTE upside lego cheap, and the 529 contracts at 1,100 plus 504 at 1,150 are the only live call OI builds in the series.
strategies.defined_risk: 13.5 points of net debit at mid = 13.5 points maximum loss, or 2,700 baht at 200 baht per point; maximum gain 36.5 points at or above 1,150.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1,040, the near put wall and the only near-money put OI shelf at 292 contracts.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,060-1,110 is the working range while net GEX stays inside its +190 to +489 week-long band - with no strike above 529 contracts, the option structure is not driving price in this series. The 1,130 gamma flip is the level that matters: spot reaching it would put dealers long gamma and start damping the trend, while a close below the 1,040 near put wall opens a 123-point gap to the 563-lot 960 structural floor. At 96 DTE this reads as a positioning map rather than a timing signal.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is recommended. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so pinning and max-pain magnetism are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks; with +450 net GEX and 96 DTE the 1,080 max pain is a reference point, not a magnet. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the 7.65- and 13.5-point debits are total losses if the structures expire worthless.
